title: Buku ya Swiletelo ya Permaculture
subtitle: Nkongomiso wa le ntirhweni wa dizayini ya permaculture, ku byala swakudya na ku hanya hi ndlela leyi tshamaka malembe yo tala, eka varimi na mimuti ya Dzonga ra Afrika.
draftNotice: Vuhundzuluxeri lebyi byi endliwile hi muchini naswona a byi si kamberiwa hi munhu loyi a vulavulaka Xitsonga kahle. Loko swin'wana swi nga twisiseki, hlaya ndzima ya Xinghezi.
credit: Yi hlengeletiwile hi Rory Clark, Imbewu Yoshintso NPC. Yi kamberiwile naswona yi pfuxetiwile eka Afrika Dzonga, 2026. Swiphemu swin'wana swi cinciwile ku suka eka Introduction to Permaculture and Homestead Gardening (2014) ya African Conservation Trust.
book: Kandziyisa kumbe u hlayisa buku hinkwayo
